title: PURSUE N400 Word Processing
description: EEG dataset from the PURSUE project containing an N400 word processing task, recorded from participants at three primarily undergraduate institutions (Southern California, Massachusetts, and Virginia) in 2017 and 2018. The task design follows the ERP CORE paradigm. The dataset supports event-related potential research on semantic word processing.
methods_description: Participants completed an N400 word processing task, with the paradigm based on ERP CORE. Data were collected at three academic institutions in 2017 and 2018. Task details are given in the supplementary materials.
